analysis.positionMethod: Original exact player matcher where available. Otherwise same supplied opaque templates scanned to originY=0 and ±12px previous x. A consistent swimming falling pose matches105/113 pixels (92.92%) because eight sprite pixels differ; position remains a partial-template inference, not exact art equivalence.

kinematicFit.method: Least-square integer screenshot position fit of a simple constant-acceleration candidate. This is inferred behavior, not an extracted engine constant.

horizontalFit.method: Grid fit of simple acceleration/braking with 2-frame effective input delay, 1px grounded speed cap and floor-to-1/32px motion, against observed grounded walk/run/reversal. Constants are inferred.
